brief: po/lanes/po-js184-brief.md, choice 2 (Q1 new token per ask; Q2 secret works once; Q3 token encrypted under a key from the secret; Q4 under an operator key)
tradeoff: None given up. About 40 lines of standard library encryption.
serves: PRODUCT.md, "Joining and signing in are easy and safe"; "Failures are invisible"; DOMAINS invariant 65, "a second or concurrent redemption gets the same token".
entry: Q3. A TV code's waiting token is stored encrypted under a key only the secret's holder can derive, so a database read signs no one in and a TV that asks again gets the same sign-in. Q1 and Q2 put a viewer back at sign-in over a lost answer; Q4 adds an operator secret to set and rotate.
